trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production. v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy there, so I rolled back to it. us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on v2.3.0 now.
- **Recovery:** checkout-api reports healthy on v2.3.0, with the error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to open INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the incident opened once. It describes the failure, the rollback, and the follow-up items.

Still open: v2.3.1 needs investigation before anyone redeploys it. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy in staging.
